Currently "Enschedese Boys" plays in the Vierde Klasse (8th tier in Dutch football).

De Grolsch Veste | De Grolsch Veste (] , English: The Grolsch Fortress , previously known as "Arke Stadion" ] ) is the stadium of football club FC Twente.  It is located in Enschede, Netherlands, at the Business & Science Park, near the University of Twente.  The stadium has an all-seated capacity of 30,205 with a standard pitch heating system and has a promenade instead of fences around the stands.  It hosted the final of the UEFA Women's Euro 2017.
Oldenzaal | Oldenzaal (] ) is a municipality and a city in the eastern province of Overijssel in the Netherlands.  It is part of the region of Twente and is close to the German border.
